Become a Patron
Embark on a journey with Frenchman Valley Cooperative (FVC) and discover the advantages of being a patron. We offer more than services; we provide a partnership that grows with you and your agricultural needs.
FVC is member-owned and has over 20 locations serving a large area in southwest Nebraska, northwest Kansas, the Nebraska Panhandle, northeast Colorado, and Wyoming. FVC provides services in agronomy, energy, feed, grain, and grain procurement.
Start Your Support
What Does it Mean to Be a Patron?
Being a patron of Frenchman Valley Coop means becoming an integral part of a community that values sustainable agriculture, shared success, and mutual support. It’s a unique opportunity to contribute to and benefit from our collective growth and achievements in the agricultural sector. Becoming a member and transacting business with FVC, allows you ownership of the business you participate in providing you value for your needs and the ability to earn equity on your purchases. If you are interested in establishing an account with FVC, we invite you to complete a credit application. While you don’t have to be a member to make purchases from FVC, we encourage you to apply for membership to add value to the business you transact with FVC.
Apply Today
300+ crops funded
Our funding has supported a wide variety of 300 different crops. This diversity underlines our commitment to promoting sustainable and prosperous agricultural practices, catering to the unique needs of different regions and farmers.
2,000+ farmers
With 2000 farmers and counting in our cooperative network, we take pride in our role as a catalyst for growth and success in the farming community.
1,000+ patrons
A Thriving Community: Surpassing 1000 patrons, our cooperative is more than a service provider; it’s a thriving community. Each patron brings unique strengths and perspectives, enriching our cooperative.
Explore our World
Step into the vibrant world of Frenchman Valley Coop events, locations, farmers, and more.

Benefits of Being a Patron
As a FVC patron, you gain access to a wealth of resources and advantages designed to support and enhance your agricultural endeavors.
Exclusive access to our top-tier agronomy, feed, energy, and grain services.
Opportunities for group-buying and discounts, aligning your success with ours.
Involvement in decision-making processes, shaping the future of the cooperative.
Access to educational resources and community events.
Strong network connections within the agricultural community.

FAQs
Got questions about becoming a patron? Browse our FAQ section for detailed insights on what it means to join Frenchman Valley Coop, and how it benefits your agricultural business and community.
Do I need to be a member of FVC to buy products/services from the coop?
No, you do not need to be a member to make purchases from the coop. We sell products/services to both members and nonmembers. While most ag producers are members of the coop, many other people who regularly buy, feed, gas, or lawn products, have their vehicle serviced are not members.
How do I become a member of FVC?
First, you should contact our Human Resources/Member Services Department. They will give you a simple form to complete and return. Two types of membership are available: Voting & Participating. To become a voting member, you must be an agricultural producer and pay $100 for your Capital Stock. Voting members can vote on issues that require a vote. Both Voting and Participating Members are eligible to earn patronage based on the business they transact with FVC each year.
When can I expect to get my equity investment redeemed from FVC?
The board of directors must authorize the time and method of any redemption of member’s equity according to the by-laws of the cooperative. They annually review the balance of equity by age group determined by the birth date of the stakeholder as well as the year the equity was earned.
When will FVC redeem the member’s equity held by a deceased person?
A representative of the estate must make a written request to the board of directors for the redemption of equity. The board reviews these requests annually to determine the time and method of any redemption of the member’s equity according to the by-laws. The redemption of equities held by the deceased persons are given priority for the settlement of their estates. FVC is currently up to date in redeeming all requested deceased member estate equities. For questions regarding a deceased member’s equity, please call 308-882-3200.
How do I open an account with FVC?
First, you will need to pick up a credit application which can be downloaded and completed. You may also call to request an application be mailed to you by contacting our Credit Manager, Krista McClain at 308-882-3212 or kmcclain@fvcoop.net. Once the application is completed, return it to one of our offices (preferable Imperial at the address listed above). FVC will then complete a credit check for you once the application is received. An account will then be opened assuming a positive result. For those of you interested in obtaining one of our FVC gas cards to save $0.03 per gallon at any of our fueling locations, please contact our Credit Manager, Krista McClain at 308-882-3212 or kmcclain@fvcoop.net.
